meta.tagline: Codex 与 Claude 的 Windows 自动续接工具
meta.desc: 支持 Codex 桌面版、Codex CLI、Claude CLI 和 Claude 桌面版的独立监测。
meta.detail: Codex 桌面版、Codex CLI、Claude CLI 与 Claude 桌面版各自设置、独立监测：额度恢复后自动续接，网络出错自动重试，可按会话设置完成后的续接任务；Codex 还可设置模型和推理强度。工具权限请求默认自动批准，可改为人工批准；Codex 桌面版不处理 ChatGPT 普通聊天和 Work 会话。单文件免安装。

specs.v: Codex 桌面版 / Codex CLI / Claude CLI / Claude 桌面版
Codex 桌面默认 5 个，可自定义；自动输入需当前可见会话
逐会话模型、推理强度与续接；CLI 和 EXE 各自独立权限设置
GitHub 与下载站双渠道，支持断点续传

meta.tagline_en: A Windows auto-continue companion for Codex and Claude
meta.intro_en: Codex desktop, Codex CLI and Claude CLI have separate settings in three tabs, with the activity log at the bottom. Desktop recent activities default to five and are configurable, with per-session model, effort and follow-ups. Supports quota recovery and bounded network retries. Full access and automatic tool approval are defaults; manual approval is available. Recent activities can be configured; automatic input requires a verified visible Codex conversation. ChatGPT chats and Work conversations are excluded. Single file, no install.
meta.detail_en: Separate settings and independent monitoring for Codex desktop, Codex CLI, Claude CLI and the Claude desktop app: sessions resume after a usage limit lifts, retry after network errors, and can each have their own follow-up; Codex sessions can also set model and effort. Tool-permission requests are approved automatically by default, or left for you. ChatGPT chats and Work conversations are not touched. Single file, no install.

specs_en.v: Codex desktop / Codex CLI / Claude CLI / Claude desktop
Five by default, configurable; automatic input requires a visible conversation
Per-session model, effort and follow-ups; separate CLI and desktop permission settings
GitHub and download-site sources, resumable downloads

companion.label: AI 助手技能 · Claude Code / Codex
companion.tagline: 让 AI 助手自己去读 Auto-Continue 的日志
companion.tagline_en: Lets your AI assistant read Auto-Continue's log
companion.note: Claude Code 和 Codex 都可安装的可选技能，用来读取活动日志、排查配置；主程序不依赖它。
companion.note_en: An optional skill for Claude Code or Codex that reads the activity log and helps diagnose settings. The executable does not need it.

items.zh: Claude EXE：用「Open in → 新窗口」弹出的 Code 会话也会被监测。弹出窗口的页面标题不带「- Claude Code」，此前整个窗口被跳过，额度续接和完成后续接对它不起作用。
items.en: Claude EXE: Code sessions opened with "Open in → new window" are watched too. Their page title lacks "- Claude Code", so such a window was skipped and got no limit resume or After finish.

items.zh: Claude CLI：回合结束后输入框里的灰色提示建议不再被当成草稿，额度续接、完成后续接和配套程序的发送不再因此被拦下。
items.en: Claude CLI: the dim prompt suggestion Claude Code shows in the input box after a turn no longer counts as a draft, so limit resumes, After finish prompts and companion sends are no longer held by it.

items.zh: Claude CLI：输入改为分段进行，在屏幕上看到整行到达后才按回车，回车生效后才切回原窗口；修复长句末尾几个字和回车落到别的窗口、却仍显示发送成功的问题。
items.en: Claude CLI: typing goes in short pieces, Enter is pressed only once the whole line shows in the input box, and the previous window comes back only after Enter took it; fixes the end of a long line and its Enter landing in another window while the send still reported success.

items.zh: 修复一键升级在 GitHub 响应慢时直接失败的问题：没有及时响应的下载源按不可用处理，改用另一个来源。
items.en: Fixes one-click updates failing outright when GitHub was slow to answer: a source that does not answer in time is treated as unreachable and the other source is used.

items.zh: 新增 Claude EXE 监测（默认关闭）：处理 Claude 桌面版里当前显示的 Code 会话，额度重置后续接、网络出错后重试、完成后按设置发送续接任务。
items.en: Adds Claude EXE monitoring (off by default) for the Code session showing in the Claude desktop app: continue after a usage limit resets, retry after network errors, and send the configured follow-up after a finished turn.

items.zh: 只在会话标题唯一对应一个桌面会话、输入框为空且没有回合在运行时才输入；写入输入框并点击应用自带的发送按钮，会话记录确认后才算发送成功。权限提示和提问留给用户。
items.en: Input only happens when the session title matches exactly one desktop session, the prompt box is empty and no turn is running; the text is written into the prompt box and sent with the app's own Send button, and counts only once the session record confirms it. Permission prompts and questions are left to you.

items.zh: Claude CLI 删除模型恢复（安全拦截时切到备用模型、/compact 后切回，以及模型额度用完自动换模型）。这类会话改为原样等待处理，不再自动输入；曾开启该功能的，首次启动时日志提示一次。
items.en: Removes Claude CLI model recovery (switching a session blocked by safeguards to a fallback model, compacting and switching back, and switching models when one model allowance runs out). Such sessions now wait for you with nothing typed; anyone who had it on is told once in the log.

items.zh: 精简 Claude CLI 监测：Claude Code 退出后留下的终端不再让每轮多等 2 秒，并去掉无用的旧设置页和旧版迁移。限额续接、网络重试、选择框与权限回答、After finish 行为不变。
items.en: Streamlines Claude CLI monitoring: a terminal where Claude Code has exited no longer adds a two-second wait to every pass, and an unused settings page and an old migration are removed. Limit resume, network retries, chooser and permission answers and After finish are unchanged.
